interface.alias_and_mutation_notes: Callable returns (out, lse); protected call exposes out and applies the oracle-derived undefined mask only where prescribed. Both partial and combine kernels remain in the call.

contracts.value: sparse paged MLA: for each query row, gather topk_length[i] fp8 KV blocks named by indices[i] (and extra_indices_in_kvcache[i] from the second/compressed pool), compute softmax(Q.K^T * softmax_scale) . V over the gathered set with a per-head attention sink, split-K over the KV axis (dpsk_v4_fp8_partial_kernel) then LSE-combine the splits (dpsk_v4_combine_kernel); returns (out[T,1,H,head_dim_v] bf16, lse[T,1,H] fp32). Both device kernels are emitted as `main_kernel`.

Selection re-probed (run #4) with markers PROVABLY INSTALLED on all 14 candidates in all 8 TP ranks: _sel4_overlay/geak_lazy_markers.py force-imports the candidate modules the live path never imports (dsa_backend, dsa.triton_sparse_mla, nsa_triton_decode) at a late trigger (first import of deepseek_v4_backend_hip_radix -- past init_process_group, before the first attention forward), which converts them from 'missing_candidate_markers' (probe omitted) into 'installed_but_never_live' (proven dead). kernel_selection.py: ok=true, deepest_verified=true, failed=[], missing_candidate_markers=[], deeper_live_candidates=[].

value.policy: cases.call()/cases._golden() zero the positions where the FROZEN ORACLE output is NaN
sources: decode_*_x1024 rows 56..63: the server pads the decode batch and the padding slots' q is uninitialised (the oracle's own q is NaN there)
prefill_m8192_x1024 rows ~1792..6047: all 1024 extra_indices_in_kvcache entries are -1 (empty extra context) so the live op's softmax denominator is empty and it returns NaN
value.note: the mask is derived from the ORACLE only and applied identically to both legs, so a candidate that invents a NaN at any DEFINED position still fails
